### Anthropic’s Revenue Surged to $17 Billion in Q3, Swung Back to Operating Loss
Anthropic reported nearly $17 billion in revenue in the third quarter ending September, up 47% from the second quarter, the latest sign that its once red-hot revenue growth rate is slowing ahead of a blockbuster IPO this month. The AI company reported a $23.3 billion net loss for the quarter, ... ### OpenAI's Grid Protectors Program: Data Centers as Emergency Power Reserves
OpenAI isn't just building data centers to train models — it's now pitching them as emergency power reserves for local grids. On Monday, OpenAI announced it will pilot its "Grid Protectors Program" at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia. ([DEV Community](https://dev.to/chandan_kumar_1afaffcf991/openais-grid-protectors-program-data-centers-as-emergency-power-reserves-1kol))

### Goldman Walls Off AI for Its Own Dealers
Goldman Walls Off AI for Its Own Dealers As of 2026-11-02 18:14 UTC, On November 2, 2026, Bloomberg reported that Goldman Sachs has restricted its traders and bankers from using some AI tools.
